selection_metric: validation cell-macro all-observed-future MAPE at source origin100
loss: MSE averaged within future targets and origins, with equal weight per battery
preprocessing: training-only raw-history and statistical-prefix imputation/weighted scaling; padded history with explicit true length and signal-availability mask
representation: GRU/LSTM/TCN/smallTransformer encode observed early cycle signal features; statistics_MLP encodes the same audited summary features used by tabular baselines. All receive the same observation budget and horizon/known-condition information, not measured capacity/SOH/EOL.
experts_or_llm: These are small dedicated sequence/statistical baselines, not pretrained SMETimes. Genuine LLM and text/random-backbone/expert ablations remain a separate forthcoming implementation.
